title: EtherCAT Configuration
description: Configure EtherCAT segments the agent masters, one per dedicated network interface.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: EtherCAT segments to master. Click 'Add' to add one, or Auto-configure to scan every network interface for slaves.

name.title: Name
name.description: Label this segment appears under in the trace and the `connection` parameter of the actions. Defaults to the interface name.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Network interface the segment hangs off (eth1, enp3s0). Dedicated to EtherCAT: no IP traffic. `demo` runs the simulated segment. On Linux the extension needs CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_NET_ADMIN.

cycle_time.title: Cycle Time (ms)
cycle_time.description: Process data cycle. 10 ms suits a non-real-time host; shorter cycles raise jitter.

enable_outputs.title: Enable Outputs
enable_outputs.description: Allow the write_output action to drive this segment's outputs. Off: every output stays zero and the action refuses. Outputs are never written at start, and return to zero when the extension stops.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every connection publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<connection>/<slave>/<pdo>'. Clear it to give each connection its own trace source with unprefixed events.

diagnostics_interval.title: Diagnostics Interval (seconds)
diagnostics_interval.description: How often the `_master` and per-slave `_state` events are logged, and how often an unchanged PDO is repeated.
